name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: A carousel for cycling through elements, images, or slides of content.

props.name: allowMouseDrag
props.description: Whether to allow scrolling via dragging with mouse

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Whether to scroll automatically. The default delay is 4000ms.

props.name: autoSize
props.description: Whether to enable variable width slides.

props.name: defaultPage
props.description:
The initial page to scroll to when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the page of the carousel.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the carousel. Useful for composition.

props.name: inViewThreshold
props.description: The threshold for determining if an item is in view.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether the carousel should loop around.

props.name: padding
props.description:
Defines the extra space added around the scrollable area,
enabling nearby items to remain partially in view.

props.name: page
props.description: The controlled page of the carousel.

props.name: slidesPerMove
props.description:
The number of slides to scroll at a time.

When set to `auto`, the number of slides to scroll is determined by the
`slidesPerPage` property.

props.name: slidesPerPage
props.description: The number of slides to show at a time.

props.name: snapType
props.description: The snap type of the item.

props.name: spacing
props.description: The amount of space between items.

events.name: onAutoplayStatusChange
events.description: Function called when the autoplay status changes.

events.name: onDragStatusChange
events.description: Function called when the drag status changes.

events.name: onPageChange
events.description: Function called when the page changes.

examples.title: Basic
examples.source:
import Carousel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/carousel/carousel.marko"; static const SLIDES = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
${item}
examples.description: Pass `items` and render each one through the tag's own body, taking the item as a default-body tag parameter. Use the previous/next triggers to move between pages.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.source:

${item}
examples.description: Set `slidesPerPage` to show more than one item at a time.

examples.title: Spacing
examples.source:
import Carousel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/carousel/carousel.marko"; static const SLIDES = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
${item}
examples.description: Set `spacing` to control the gap between items.

examples.title: Orientation
examples.source:
import Carousel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/carousel/carousel.marko"; static const SLIDES = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
${item}
examples.description: Set `orientation` to `vertical` to stack slides top to bottom.

examples.title: API
examples.source:
import Carousel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/carousel/carousel.marko"; static const SLIDES = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
${item}
Slide ${page + 1} of ${SLIDES.length}
examples.description: A `<Carousel/carouselApi/>` tag-variable capture gives you the live, reactive machine api — read `carouselApi().page` and `carouselApi().pageSnapPoints` directly, no `setApi`/`useEffect` subscription needed.

examples.title: Autoplay
examples.source:
import Carousel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/carousel/carousel.marko"; static const SLIDES = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
${item}
examples.description: Our carousel is backed by `@zag-js/carousel`, which has autoplay built in — pass `autoplay={ delay }` instead of an Embla plugin, and call `api().pause()` / `api().play()` to stop on hover.

examples.title: RTL
examples.description: `dir="rtl"` is a real machine prop: it flips scroll direction, keyboard arrows, and item order. The previous/next icons already carry `mu-rtl-flip` in the component, so no extra classes are needed.

examples.title: Loop
examples.source:
import Carousel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/carousel/carousel.marko"; static const SLIDES = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];
${item}
examples.description: Set `loop` so the carousel wraps around at the first and last slide.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import Carousel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/carousel/carousel.marko"; static const SLIDES = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5];

Page: ${page}

${item}
examples.description: The carousel is controlled: a `page` prop without `pageChange` never moves. Pair the two to drive the current page from your own state.

examples.title: Compound (attr tags)
examples.source:
import Carousel from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/carousel/carousel.marko"; <@slide>
1
<@slide>
2
<@slide>
3
examples.description: Use `<@slide>` attribute tags instead of `items=` to compose each slide's markup directly.

body.description:
Render prop for `items=` entries.

The item is `T | undefined`, not `T`: a bodyless `<@slide/>` produces an
entry with no datum, and the render path below deliberately still invokes
this body for it (see the comment at the call site — the render prop owns
placeholder slides). Declaring it as `T` promised a value this component
does not always pass.

composition: `Carousel` is a single component, not four. Where upstream composes `Carousel` / `CarouselContent` / `CarouselItem` / `CarouselPrevious` / `CarouselNext`, this port folds the item group, previous/next triggers, and a page-indicator group into `Carousel` itself: pass `items=` and render each one through the tag's own body, taking the item as a default-body tag parameter (or use `@slide` attr tags for static markup), and the component renders the scroll container, buttons, and indicators for you. There is no separate `CarouselContent`, `CarouselItem`, `CarouselPrevious`, or `CarouselNext` tag to import.
